summary: Toro Corp. filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026 attaching a press release announcing its intention to spin off its LPG carrier business into AI OKTO CORP., which is expected to list on the Nasdaq Capital Market. AI OKTO's initial assets comprise two LPG carriers, LPG Dream Arrax and LPG Dream Vermax, plus $45 million cash contributed by Toro. Toro shareholders receive AI OKTO shares without payment or action; fractional shares are aggregated and sold with net proceeds distributed pro rata. The transaction requires Board approval on the recommendation of a disinterested and independent special committee, an effective Form 20-F registration statement, and Nasdaq listing approval. Chairman and CEO Petros Panagiotidis will hold the same roles at AI OKTO. Watch for the registration statement going effective, the record and distribution dates, and the when-issued trading setup for a potential stub-arbitrage opportunity between TORO and the pure-play AI OKTO entity.
